name: Bryan Catanzaro

affiliations.role: Vice President, Applied Deep Learning Research; leads the Nemotron effort

bio: Bryan Catanzaro is Vice President of Applied Deep Learning Research at NVIDIA, where the team applies deep learning to areas from graphics to chip design, and is associated with the Nemotron open model effort. Catanzaro co-authored the Deep Speech and Deep Speech 2 speech recognition papers during time at Baidu and helped start the cuDNN library.
known_for: VP of Applied Deep Learning Research at NVIDIA
